comparison.objective: Load four flat aluminium blanks into a close-clearance gravity magazine.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated planar squaring, narrow-mouth insertion, stacking, and jam avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: All four blanks lie flat, centred, supported, below the rim, and at rest.
comparison.reason: Repeated close-clearance insertion is materially different from sequential impact fracture and retrieval of freed tang fragments.
